answers.core: Importing models and materials is core to creating a 3D game. It may be possible to use an add-on, but is more accessible if this is just an optional setting built into the Godot importer. I think that workflow benefits like this have the ability to affect any 3D game since material sharing can be used in a variety of ways: i.e. materials used as color palettes, shared materials in low poly games, trim sheet materials in higher res games, etc.
answers.workaround: I think this might be possible using a custom script when importing, but I have not learned enough about that yet.

title: Allow importing materials from a glTF scene to a specific folder
